titel: Buttermilk substitute from milk and lemon
kurz: Milk with a little lemon juice turns sour and slightly thick in a few minutes. For baking, it replaces buttermilk.
bild_im_kopf: Like a body double: does not look quite the same, but plays the role in the batter just as well.
material: 1 tbsp lemon juice or mild vinegar
verwendung: Pancakes, scones, Zopf and cakes that call for buttermilk.
Marinade for chicken: the mild acidity makes the surface tender.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Put lemon juice in a measuring jug and top up with milk to 250 ml

schluesselmomente.warum: The milk protein starts to curdle, and the milk thickens and forms fine flakes.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Use in the batter together with baking soda
schluesselmomente.warum: The acid reacts with [[natron|baking soda]] to make [[kohlendioxid|carbon dioxide]]: [[g-pancakes|pancakes]] and scones rise.
